title: Solar Light With Motion Sensor – Three Heads, 210 LED
seo_title: Solar Light With Motion Sensor – 3 Heads, 210 LED
seo_description: Solar-powered outdoor light with motion sensor, three adjustable heads and 210 LEDs. Installs without any wiring – no electrician needed.
descriptionHtml:
The keyhole you never find in the dark

You come home in the dark and fumble for the keyhole with your phone light in one hand. A hardwired light would have needed an electrician and new cables in the wall — and a corded light ends with an extension cord that freezes fast in the snow until spring.

No wiring, no electrician

The solar light mounts on the wall without a single cable. The solar panel charges the built-in 1200 mAh battery during the day, and when the motion sensor detects you approaching, the three heads light up with a total of 210 LEDs. Each head turns separately, so you aim the light at the driveway, the steps or the keyhole — not just straight ahead.

Features

  • You stop fumbling for the keyhole in the dark – the motion sensor lights the three heads with 210 LEDs as you walk up.
  • No electrician, no cabling – the light mounts on the wall and is charged by the built-in solar panel.
  • The light goes where you actually need it – all three heads turn separately, toward the driveway, the steps or the garage door.
  • No need to think about charging – the solar panel tops up the built-in 1200 mAh battery as long as the light sits in sunlight.
  • Wide light instead of a narrow beam – 210 LEDs spread across three heads.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
